summary: Phase-17 backend + frontend validation on the public preview URL. Backend HTTP endpoints /api/strategy-sweep and /api/ss-optimizer are fully working per spec (6/7 new HTTP tests pass). Backend module-level pytest still 13/13 green. Frontend: two new tabs (Strategy Optimizer, SS Optimizer) render, execute, and Apply-winner correctly. Two DEFECTS found: (1) FRONTEND — RothComplianceCard component is defined in /app/frontend/src/components/Projection.jsx (line 153) but is NEVER rendered/invoked in the JSX tree — neither `roth-compliance-clear` nor `roth-compliance-warning` ever appears on the Projection tab, blocking a review-request bullet. (2) BACKEND — POST /api/projection with `roth.year_targets` sent as a JSON object (keys must be strings over HTTP) is silently ignored — projection.py line 869 does `plan.year_targets.get(year, plan.target_rate)` with int `year`, missing the string keys, so total_roth_converted matches the flat run instead of the phased run.

critical.issue: roth.year_targets is ignored when submitted via HTTP because JSON forces string keys ('2026') but projection.py:869 looks up with int year (year_targets.get(year, ...)). Reproduces: send scenario with roth.year_targets={'2026':0.32,...} — response's total_roth_converted equals the flat-target result. Same test passes in-process because Python test uses int keys directly. Fix: normalize keys in projection._parse_plan (e.g. year_targets={int(k):v for k,v in (roth.get('year_targets') or {}).items()}).

ui_bugs.issue: RothComplianceCard component defined at Projection.jsx:153 but is never invoked in the JSX render tree. `data-testid='roth-compliance-clear'` never mounts on the Multi-Year Projection tab on the default V9 scenario (waited 8s post-load, projection charts loaded, but neither compliance card testid exists). Backend response includes roth_compliance correctly — this is a pure wiring miss. Fix: render <RothComplianceCard compliance={result.roth_compliance} /> inside Projection.jsx alongside the summary cards.

action_items: FRONTEND: In /app/frontend/src/components/Projection.jsx, invoke <RothComplianceCard compliance={result.roth_compliance} /> inside the JSX render tree — it is currently only defined and never mounted. This blocks the 'roth-compliance-clear (green) on default V9 scenario' review bullet.

BACKEND: Fix /app/backend/projection.py:_parse_plan (~line 629) to normalize year_targets keys to int at parse time — e.g. `year_targets={int(k): v for k, v in (roth.get('year_targets') or {}).items()}`. Currently JSON string keys silently no-op because line 869 uses `plan.year_targets.get(year, plan.target_rate)` with an int year.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:99-107 StrategySweepRequest — schema matches frontend api.js payload; irmaa_cap is Optional[int] which is correct for the 'No cap' dropdown value=None.
server.py:109-111 SsOptimizerRequest — ages: Optional[List[int]] correctly defaults to full [62,65,67,70] sweep inside sweep_ss_claims.

projection.py:869 — plan.year_targets.get(year, plan.target_rate): when year_targets originates from JSON its keys are strings while `year` is int; the lookup silently falls back. Add key normalization in _parse_plan for HTTP safety.

Projection.jsx:153-180 — RothComplianceCard is well-written (green clean-state + red warnings table with per-conversion 5-year clock hints) but the parent component never mounts it. Verified with `grep -c RothComplianceCard Projection.jsx` returning 1 (only the declaration). Zero JSX usages.

StrategyOptimizer.jsx — sort toggle correctly re-sorts the underlying array; visible top-10 rows tie on nominal/PV for the default scenario because Fill-32% converges at the RMD wall for many stop_years. Not a bug, but consider showing a small 'ties broken by lifetime tax' note in the UI header.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://roth-retirement-tool.preview.emergentagent.com. Two open defects logged in action_items. Both new sweep endpoints take ~10-15s to complete on the default 37-year plan (frontend timeouts of 90s are ample). Key testids confirmed live: tab-strategy, tab-ssopt, strategy-{controls,irmaa-cap,max-annual,include-phased,run,winner,results,sort-nominal,sort-pv,apply,empty}, ss-{controls,run,winner,results,fra-amounts,apply,empty}. Missing: roth-compliance-{clear,warning} (defined but not mounted). Backend request payloads use `{config: scenario, ...}` NOT `{scenario: ...}`. To repro the year_targets bug via curl: POST /api/projection with body {config: <DEFAULT_SCENARIO with roth.year_targets={'2026':0.32,'2027':0.32,'2028':0.24,'2029':0.24}>} — total_roth_converted returns 3,890,426.83 (identical to flat 0.24 run) instead of the phased result.
rca of the issue: Defect #1 (RothComplianceCard): grep confirms only the declaration exists; Projection.jsx parent JSX omits the <RothComplianceCard/> element. Simple wiring miss, one-line fix. Defect #2 (year_targets ignored via HTTP): JSON.parse produces string-keyed object; projection.py line 869 uses `.get(year, ...)` where `year` is int → miss → falls back to plan.target_rate. Fix at parse boundary: `year_targets = {int(k): float(v) for k, v in (roth.get('year_targets') or {}).items()}` in _parse_plan (~line 629).
